about: The one ISO 8601 instant grammar every Polaris verifier accepts (2026-09-24). Both reference SDKs and the detached verifier must give these answers; null is refused.

cases.why: impossible date; Date.UTC rolled it to 3 March
compact form; Python 3.11 fromisoformat accepts it
week date; Python 3.11 fromisoformat accepts it
hour only; Python 3.11 fromisoformat accepts it
an offset of 24 hours is not one RFC 3339 allows; the TypeScript SDK read it (2026-10-01)
nor is 60 minutes; both SDKs read it as +02:00
Arabic-Indic digits; Python's \d matched them and int() converted them
year 99, read as written; Date.UTC read years 0 to 99 as 1900 onwards
there is no year 0 in the Python reference
a file separator, which Python's strip() removed and trim() did not
a byte-order mark, which trim() removed and Python's strip() did not
a trailing newline, which Python's $ let through before strip() was dropped
